t: This is Down Street, also called Down Street Mayfair, a disused station on the London Underground. The Great Northern, Piccadilly and Brompton Railway opened it in 1907. In its working life it was served by the Piccadilly line, between Dover Street, now called Green Park, and Hyde Park Corner. It was designed by Leslie Green, an English architect best known for the stations he built across central London in the first decade of the twentieth century. They have oxblood red faïence blocks, pillars and semi-circular first-floor windows, and tiled interiors in the Modern Style.
